# Extension menu icons request eager loading only when the generated image is present

The menu-icon setter resolves the extension icon, encodes its URI with ChromeUtils.encodeURIForSrcset and schedules a Promise microtask from the menu's documentGlobal. The callback queries .menu-icon and sets its loading property to eager only if the node exists. It has no retry or proof that toolkit construction is complete. The root and explicit-item callers determine which icons receive this request; icon removal clears the classes and image attribute. The source comment's lazy-loading viewport explanation and paint guarantee remain unverified by this comm-only check. No rendered popup or extension test ran.

Scope: WebExtension context-menu icon timing.
